title: The $500 Billion AI Infrastructure Boost
summary: Refining constraints and third-party AI funding.
assessment: The refining bottleneck and proposed infrastructure financing are well grounded. The strongest caveats concern accounting and causal inference: a crack spread is a margin, leases usually remain on balance sheet, and faster hiring by AI adopters does not prove economy-wide job creation. Long-horizon Bitcoin and option outcomes remain open.

claims.claim: Refining constraints drive expensive diesel.
claims.reason: EIA’s subsequent review confirms unusually high distillate margins and disrupted refining. This supports the distinction between crude availability and refined-product supply. It does not establish that crude scarcity plays no role or that every regional benchmark set a record.

evidence.title: Third-quarter crude prices and refinery margins
evidence.finding: Distillate and jet-fuel spreads were highest amid refining disruption in Russia, China and the Middle East.

evidence.title: Higher fuel prices and crack spreads
evidence.finding: Distillate spreads exceeded gasoline spreads; late-August distillate inventories were 14% below their five-year average.

claims.claim: The crack spread measures refining cost.
claims.reason: A 3-2-1 spread is a theoretical gross refining margin: product value less crude input cost, normalized per barrel. It is not the operating cost of refining. Energy, labor, maintenance and other costs must still be deducted to estimate net profitability.

evidence.finding: Defines the spread as the theoretical refining margin in dollars per barrel.

claims.claim: Leasing redistributes infrastructure investment risk.
claims.reason: Third-party ownership can transfer residual hardware risk and upfront financing. The article expressly acknowledges multiyear customer obligations and only partial risk transfer. Ordinary operating leases generally create right-of-use assets and lease liabilities under ASC 842, so this is not an automatic removal of balance-sheet obligations. A compute-service contract also requires separate analysis of whether it contains a lease.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Map who finances an investment and who ultimately pays for its output.
Accounting labels do not erase economic obligations.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
